intended_object: The matrix B_t = (1−t)I + tA, where A = S₁^{-1/2}(S₁^{1/2} S₂ S₁^{1/2})^{1/2} S₁^{-1/2} is the Brenier/optimal transport matrix from N(·,S₁) to N(·,S₂). B_t is the linear part of McCann's displacement interpolation between the two Gaussians. This comes from the docstring and the module documentation (Agueh–Carlier).
